type.description: The type of tracking (e.g., submission, comment_reply, start, continue, next, prev, submit_partial, submit, time_elapsed_submit, time_enabled_force_exit, review)

submission.description: The data payload for assignment tracking (required for assignment type submissions)

id.description: The reply identifier (required only when type is comment_reply)

learner_reply.description: The text of the reply (required only when type is comment_reply)

name.description: The title of the submitted assignment (required only when type is submission)

description.description: An optional description of the submitted assignment

files.description: An array of uploaded S3 file URLs (required only when type is submission)

video_url.description: The URL submitted in the assignment (required only when type is submission)

action.description: The action to perform on this quiz (required for quiz type)

questions.description: An object containing the quiz answers to submit, indexed by question ID (required for quiz type)

answer.description: The answer to this question (required for certain question types)

answers.description: An object containing a list of answers (required for certain question types)

bookmark.description: The last slide number played by the learner (for slides) or video offset reached by the user (for video)

complete.description: Set to TRUE if the video is completed (for video type)

submitted.description: Submit the poll as completed (for survey type)
